reason: The upstream docs tree (1,268 files) is read as input and not ported: the Go project keeps hand-written design documents under docs/harness and generates its reference catalogues (tools, events, config, services, commands, persisted event types) from Go source with a freshness check; the upgrade guides and persistence change records describe upstream release and format history that DH-ADR-2 does not carry, and the Chinese translations are not carried.

title: Keep the spine services and the rule that features attach as listeners or providers, with the driver behind the agent factory seat
One driver goroutine per agent; atomic appends per session with ordered delivery outside the lock; bounded parallel tool calls
Cancellation is a context.Context with a typed cause recorded on turn/end
Events are typed keys declared by their owning package; durable session event types are registered in a table
Four dispatch forms (notify, ordered, parallel, around with separate request and result types); interception returns closed decision types and guards stay deny-only
A capability seam is a Go interface in a contract package, a typed service key and provider components, in a direct or registry shape
An agent's scope is its own cordis fiber for lifetime plus an explicit scope key for registry visibility and filtered dispatch
The initiating agent travels in context.Context instead of ambient async storage
Components are the unit of composition; Go packages follow capability families and an import-graph test enforces dependency direction
Model-visible means logged is enforced by construction: a model request can only be built from the session log
Immutability by ownership and copying at boundaries, not by deep-freezing
Reference documentation is generated from Go source with a freshness check; the upstream docs tree is not copied
